notes.title: Patchlog v.2.8.0
notes.content:
Hello guardians,
our weekly report:

During the last week we have made very big changes on BACK TO THE EGG!
We can finally say that it is a complete tower defense game now. 

 Log 


 Towers can only get builded on sockets
 Towers can get upgraded
 The player no longer gets attacked
 A level consists of 10 waves
 Nexus and portal can not get destroyed anymore
 New UI elements
 Some towers can only attack flying mobs while other can attack grounded mobs or both
 Level design
 Disabled passive skills


However the entire game is now much more challenging.

Check out the new version and tell us what you think! :)

Greets,
Jannick and Giancarlo

notes.title: Patchlog v.2.7.1
notes.content:
Hello Dragonguards,

let us present you the current patchlog. Alot of gameplay adjustments and balancing this time.

 Patchlog 

 Implemented the Steam Cloud (steam account based saving)
 Much much more enemies are now spawning
 Improved performance
 Changed the way of buildings items
 Added more music
 Set arrow shoot distance to 50 meters (164 feet)

 Enemies getting stronger each wave
 New Steam Achievements
 Adjusted amount of gained experience by opening the treasure box


Tell us what you think :)

Greets!

notes.title: Patch v2.7.0
notes.content:
Hello Dragonguards,

The results of the last few days are listed below :)

 Patchlog 

 New character armory (different skins are dropable soon)
 Steam Leaderboards
 Player noises, shouts and other sentences
 You are now able to shoot AND run/walk
 Enemies are now attacking towers

 Removed saving gold in profile (gold only exists in levels and does not get saved anymore)
 You can now build as many towers and traps as you like

 You do not get any gold back when you remove buildings
 Tower health is now visible


 Info

Currently we are working on stuff like tower upgrades, an inventory system, active hero skills and so much more...  ːsteamhappyː

Drop us some feedback if you would like to get in touch with us :)

notes.title: Patch v2.6.5
notes.content:
Hello Dragonguards,

We promised to update the game nearly every week. Here is the result of the last week:

 Patchlog 

 Added the passive skill system
 Added the player leveling system 
 Added treasure chests after victory
 Added new maps
 Working Steam achievements

 New Tower: Canon (ranged, aoe)
 New Enemie: Goblin Bomber (range enemie)

 Guardians protecting the portals
 Tower range outline
 Teleport back to the dragon egg
 Fixed Towers
 Fixed perfomance issues
 Critical hits
 Worked on UI
 Playtime counter (wave)


 Info

We are highly motivated to continue developing the game as you can see. Please feel free to comment your ideas, suggestions or problems. We still aim to work with you together ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:
Log

Instead of playing different characters you can now create your own profile character. We added this to be prepared for the inventory and skill system which we will add later on. We want you to be able to be identify yourself more with the character you are playing so in this patch we made a professional character overhaul.

Please drop us some feedback :)

Greets,
Giancarlo and Jannick

notes.title: Patch v2.1
notes.content:
Log


     Added the wave list (replay waves → preparation for the loot system)
     Able to create profiles
     UI changes
     Fixed smaller bugs
     Improved usability


The game is no longer an endless game. You finish the first chapter after defeating all enemies of wave 20.

Currently we are working on the new character-, inventory- and loot system to bring you more content.

Greets,
Jannick and Giancarlo :)

notes.title: Patch v1.3.0
notes.content:
New Features 

     Safed player profiles
     Killing monsters, building the towers and finishing a round now gives you dragonsouls
     Weapon upgrade system (you can find the button to open the menu in the character selection) 


 Fixes 

     Performance adjustments
     Small bugs


 Info 

The weapon upgrade system is only the first part of a bigger system. One of the next patches will contain an armory system (your character starts with low/bad armor that you upgraded too!).

For any ideas or feedback please send us a mail (back-to-the-egg@jaudalabs.com).

Greets,
Jannick :)

We are really motivated to continue developing this into an awesome title!

Greets, 
Jannick
